placementGuidance.notes: The carpet is independent from walls, baseboard, props, and baked shadows so its y position, scale, and crop can be tuned without repainting the room. The baseboard is not rendered in the current pass so bedroom props sit directly on carpet against the wall.

qaNotes: Carpet contains no wall, baseboard, props, characters, labels, text, or baked object shadows.
Bleeded export includes 400px horizontal padding on each side around the 4320px visible bedroom span.
Runtime export uses a soft alpha fade at the top edge so the carpet can tuck against the wall without a visible rectangular seam.
Off-cream tone keeps the floor readable under flashlight and spotlight while retaining dusty domestic wear.
Generated source should remain candidate until art-direction review confirms the texture is painterly enough for final production.
